center: coord@399 (topocentric, SITE_COORD east-longitude, latitude, altitude km)

definition.rise_set: refracted apparent elevation crosses 0 deg: level horizon, no dip (JPL default RTS cut-off)
definition.jplFlags: JPL's own R_T_S_ONLY flags, 1 minute step; they include the dip of the site altitude
definition.times: seconds after 00:00 UT on `date`, interpolated from a 1 minute table (resolution ~1 s)
definition.samples: airless and refracted apparent azimuth/elevation, degrees, at `t` seconds after 00:00 UT
